Name: Recolors for the Gold Clock with recolored hands
Author: Allayna
Description:
I have enjoyed the Victorian retextures by Eemiestardew, but hated how the Gold Clock stuck out like a sore thumb. So, I decided to do some coloring!
The color pallets are based upon Eemiestardew's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891/?]Seasonal Victorian[/url] buildings.
You can choose one that you think is pretty, or add them to a mod that does Seasonal stuff, like [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-seasonal-immersion.4262/updates]Seasonal Immersion Mod[/url] or [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1099/?]Customize Exterior[/url].
Also included is a version of cursors.xnb that has black clock hands. Keep in mind this will affect the clock at the Community Center.
